# OmniTune v0.9.5

This release focuses heavily on visual polish and UI fidelity, bringing the premium design details of Velune into OmniTune.

### Visual & UX Upgrades
* **Squiggly Sliders:** The main playback seek bar and the volume slider (inside the Player Options menu) now use a custom wavy slider that actively animates while music is playing, providing a delightful "subtle figure" look.
* **Smooth Background Transitions:** The fullscreen player background now features a buttery-smooth 1000ms crossfade animation when the dominant colors change between songs.
* **Detailed Artist Page:** The Artist screen has been completely overhauled. Instead of a single flat list, it now categorizes content beautifully: Albums and Singles are displayed in horizontal scrolling carousels with rounded thumbnails, while top songs are presented in a clean vertical list.

*(Note: These visual upgrades were implemented carefully on top of OmniTune's existing data layer to ensure 100% stability with your current library and database.)*
